args.function: Provide a learnable physical assessment that distinguishes persistence of the original planted root from observed deterioration, new growth or propagation. Report unknowns when the available examination cannot distinguish these outcomes.

Require actual reach and an explicit specimen identity before any examination.
args.inputs: An existing planted root specimen and its recorded provenance; any additional real materials must be specified before use.
args.costs: Method, duration and energy cost are unknown. Specify bounded work, disturbance risks and cancellation behavior before execution.
args.effects: Produce dated evidence about the examined specimen and limits of inference. Preserve the specimen where feasible, disclose any destructive sampling, and do not create growth, food, fertility or viability merely through assessment.
